Alex — thanks, got the files and the notes. Quick answers below, then looping in Marissa for signage/collateral ops and Lauren for on-site staffing planning.

- Backwall/Monitor: Yes, we'll mount a 42in monitor centered on the 12ft backwall. We plan a raised shelf at ~36in for the demo unit and the monitor at ~54in centerline. Please reserve that sightline and any power run notes.
- Visitor flow: We want a soft pull toward the center corridor. Plan one intro banner on the left approach and a tall totem on the corner that signals demos inside. Avoid placing promotional tables that block the left aisle.
- Badges: Redwood will print sponsor badges (we prefer control over names). I will provide sponsor_badge_list.csv by EOD Sep 28. Can you confirm bleed specs for the badge stock?

Also attaching signage_specs_v2.xlsx (internal) with proposed billboard sizes and placement; Marissa, please review the font/logo clearspace requirements and flag anything that needs vendor confirmation.

Thanks,

Priya / Lauren — I reviewed Alex's heatmap and Priya's specs. A few ops notes and asks for decisions before we place signage orders: 

1) Signage sizes: based on sightlines we should shift the 8ft hanging banner 3ft toward Gate C (left) to avoid occlusion from neighboring island K21 during peak hours. See signage_specs_v2.xlsx for dimensions.
2) Vendor: Alex recommended DeltaPromos for on-site totems (they do quick reprints). Alex, can you confirm contact? Alex — pls introduce DeltaPromos contact to Samir at ACME who handles our badge templates.
3) Power: the monitor + LED demo lighting will need a single 20A circuit and an AV drop. Alex — can you add that to the contractor scope?
4) Collateral counts: recommend 600 one-pagers, 300 quick-start cards, and 150 premium leave-behind booklets. If we go sponsor-supplied badges we add 200 lanyards to the crate manifest.

I attached a short checklist to this thread (referenced in the Drive link). If Priya can approve the shifted banner placement and collateral counts today, I'll push PO to DeltaPromos and Felipe (print vendor).
